items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: I guess he sort of looks a little bit like Beans.

ctx.x: What is that? Is that somebody? No, that's the man you met the other night in the apartment. Oh yeah, yeah.
I guess he sort of looks a little bit like Beans.
He does. Well Beansy was here, Beansy met him.
